name: team-local
description: The team workflow on local Lemonade models only (Cline + provider lemonade, no cloud anywhere): Qwen3.8-27B builds and plans, gemma-4-31B (another family, with vision) reviews, same-model rework for 3 rounds, then the fallback dev model Devstral-Small-2-24B takes the task over on a sibling card (started at once); only when the fallback fails too does the card go to the orchestrator. Every route (dev, plan, QA, fallback) is vetted (kanban models vet, 2026-10-10)

dev.note: Cline on the dev tier's pick (Qwen3.8-27B, vetted for dev 2026-10-10)

qa.note: gemma-4-31B QAT (vetted for QA 2026-10-10): another family (google) than the Qwen dev and Devstral fallback models, with vision, so it reads screenshots; replaced Gemma-4-12B (2026-10-11)

plan.note: plans run on the dev tier's model in Cline's plan mode (--plan), so a plan card needs no model swap

fallback.note: fallback dev model (Devstral-Small-2-24B, a third family, vetted for dev 2026-10-10) on the dev role's agent

candidates.note: in use (vetted for plan 2026-10-10): the dev model, so a plan card needs no model swap
candidate (vetted for plan 2026-10-10): the fallback dev model; 65536 context as Lemonade loads it

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (the dev tier's model) in Cline's plan mode (--plan).

fallback.note: Same structure as team: after reworkRounds FAILs, a QA stall, an unchanged rework or an unresolved conflict the fallback sibling starts at once (local runs cost 0). Outages are waited out and then go to the orchestrator: every model is on the same Lemonade server, so a fallback can't get around its outage.

dev.note: dev pick (vetted 2026-10-10): tool-calling + vision, a dense 27B (17.2 GB at UD-Q4_K_XL); Lemonade loads it at 65536 (its max is 262144)
the fallback dev model (tier senior), vetted for dev: tool-calling + vision, 65536 context as Lemonade loads it
candidate: coding + tool-calling labels, 131072 context; dense 24B, slower. Calibration v11 saw it answer with <run_commands> text instead of native tool calls
candidate, vetted for dev (2026-10-09): tool-calling + vision, 131072 context as Lemonade loads it
candidate, untested: a custom import with the tool-calling label and a 1M context (the KV cache at that size may not fit next to anything else)

qa.note: QA pick (vetted 2026-10-10): another family (google) than the Qwen dev and Devstral fallback models, vision + tool-calling, 17.6 GB at Q4_0 (QAT); Lemonade loads it at 98304
provisional: stalled twice as notes' QA (2026-10-09, no output); text-only, a dense 24B with a large KV cache (160 KB/token)
candidate (provisional for QA): a vision model that is also strong at code, but from the dev model's family (Qwen), so it can't review a dev card

senior.note: fallback dev model (escalate.to, vetted for dev 2026-10-10): a third family (Mistral), neither the Qwen dev model nor the Gemma QA model, so its sibling is still reviewed by Gemma. Started without approval (local runs cost 0); the core never hands a task onto the card's own model and sends a fallback sibling that fails to the orchestrator, so the takeover happens once

tierRules.dev: Lemonade models with the tool-calling label; cost 0
tierRules.qa: a different vendor (model family) than the dev model
tierRules.senior: the fallback dev model: a family other than dev and QA

tierNotes.dev: Memory budget (one GPU: Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 96 GB GPU-addressable of 125 GB RAM): dev + QA + fallback must stay resident side by side within 80 GB, leaving 16 GB headroom. Weights (Lemonade's sizes) at the contexts Lemonade loads them with: Qwen3.8-27B 17.2 GB at 65536, gemma-4-31B QAT 17.6 GB at 98304, Devstral-Small-2-24B 14.2 GB at 65536: 49 GB of weights, plus each model's KV cache at that context and ~1.5 GB compute buffers each (all three are dense models, so their KV caches are larger than the MoE/MLA models' were: check the free memory with all three loaded before raising a context). Change a context with lemonade load <model> --ctx-size <n> --llamacpp vulkan --save-options, and keep Lemonade's max_loaded_models at 3. kanban bench calibrate can still compare candidates
tierNotes.qa: requireDifferentVendor reads the family from the model id (GLM → zai, Devstral → mistral, Qwen → qwen, Gemma → google, DeepSeek → deepseek)

settings.why: Lemonade/llama.cpp ends Cline turns without the TaskComplete hook; only the turn detector in mode on ends them (report only logs), or every card sits running with an idle TUI

local models need recovery to act: a no-images rejection or an overflowing context is cleared (/clear) and resent, and a Lemonade outage (connection refused, /health down) is held and probed instead of escalated
recovery must not be switched off for this project
